narrative.intro: Fluor Marine Propulsion has $4B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Fluor Marine Propulsion won 2 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $2B. Fluor Marine Propulsion obligations are up 12.9% year over year. Fluor Marine Propulsion received $2B from the Department of Defense and $2B from the Department of Energy in FY2026 to date. Fluor Marine Propulsion annual obligations rose from $3.1B in FY21 to $3.6B in FY22, then remained around $3.5B in FY23 and FY24 before returning to $3.6B in FY25 and increasing to $4B in FY26. FY2026 totals are fiscal year to date, so the current numbers are partial. Fluor Marine Propulsion figures here are contract obligations except where a specific table denotes award-value or total contract value. This overview highlights who buys from Fluor Marine Propulsion, how much the company is receiving this fiscal year, and how that compares with recent fiscal years.
